公司简介: Guangzhou Shuo Fan International Freight Forwarding Co., Ltd. is a company dedicated to providing professional international freight forwarding services to a large number of customers. It includes sea freight booking agent services, and also provides logistics agent auxiliary services such as import and export customs declaration agent services. The service area mainly covers the international container terminals of Nansha Port, Yantian Port, Shekou Port, Ningbo Port, Shanghai Port, Qingdao Port, etc. Based on the domestic mature freight forwarding network, our company can provide customers with convenient, efficient and high-quality import and export sea transportation and customs clearance agency services! Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and most countries in the Middle East have cooperative overseas freight forwarders, which can provide the consignee with advantageous value-added services such as DDU and DDP.
